purpose: Maps the v44 caregiver demand/friction signal into the same canonical Stödassistenten regression system without creating a separate caregiver engine.

mappings.product_miss: The existing relative_care route was optimized for hidden near-relative benefit and intentionally detected only explicit benefit or severe/life-threatening illness. The product therefore missed ordinary natural caregiver situations even after the 2026 law clarified municipal support and a support-contact duty, and fail-closed benefit outcomes still pointed only to Försäkringskassan instead of separating the municipal route.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Extend the existing relative_care capability only. Use a bounded care_context=municipal_support or near_relative_benefit when the natural-language facts already establish the route family, skip benefit-only questions for a clearly municipal caregiver-support query, and ask the older/long-term illness/disability scope question only when it can change the route after a benefit path fails closed. No caregiver app, duplicate matcher or separate truth layer.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Do not put names, relationship details beyond the coarse actor, diagnosis, exact health narrative, employer, work schedule, municipality-specific case data or raw caregiver story in handoff, public eval feedback or learning events. The optional handoff context is limited to the coarse route family.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Current Socialtjänstlag 13 kap. 9 § governs the national caregiver-support/support-contact duty, Försäkringskassan governs near-relative benefit, and the responsible municipality governs exact local services and access. Do not infer cash payment, a guaranteed local respite measure, benefit eligibility or local service availability. The normalized municipal caregiver-support record stays NEEDS_REVIEW with human review required and zero AI-promoted material fields.
